description.short: Control your local Copilot sessions from a private Teams chat.
description.full: Select or create Copilot sessions, follow work progress, answer pending questions, and change supported session settings. Access is restricted to the configured owner and tenant.

commands.title: !sessions
commands.description: Find a main or side source, then !use its name or ID.

commands.title: !history
commands.description: Read the latest ten meaningful messages. Optional count: 1 to 50.

commands.title: !status
commands.description: Show the current source and notification status.

commands.title: !subscribe
commands.description: Receive future results from the exact selected source.

commands.title: !unsubscribe
commands.description: Stop that source's future subscription notifications.

commands.title: !help
commands.description: Show native chat and explicit ! command help.
